'''2000 King Con Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed held in Västerås, Sweden on 19 February 2000. [[Patrik Wallgren]] won it. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d267">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-king-con-vasteras-sweden-20-21-febd267/ king-con-vasteras-sweden-20-21-feb], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 20 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-king-con-vasteras-sweden-20-21-febd267/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 King Con Sunday tournament]].

* '''Date:''' 19 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Västerås, Sweden
* '''Winner:''' [[Patrik Wallgren]]
